scope: Static source review and extracted administrative refusal check fixtures only; no Cargo build, QEMU or USB operations.

limitations: Only simulated HID/FTDI with config1/alternate0; no ECM/nonzero-alt journal runtime acceptance.

source_review.name: api_contract
source_review.evidence: CLI success is unwrapped data; pending records/schema_version/next_after and reconcile status/observation match current product. CLI JSON failures now require ok=false and exact semantic reason.

source_review.name: privilege_and_scope
source_review.evidence: Host refuses root and uses private Unix socketpair/QMP/FTDI; guest checks PID1 and dedicated command-line marker before sysfs/device operations; root-only binds are fixed synthetic usbhid/ftdi_sio paths after same-generation baseline comparison.

source_review.name: ordinary_service_identity
source_review.evidence: Guest ordinary_identity and server_identity explicitly return on UID/capability/exe/starttime/node-FD failure; pre-KILL call is direct, then one UID1000 SIGKILL and actual wait137; stdin FIFO held open.

source_review.name: normal_then_restart
source_review.evidence: Normal actual HID/FTDI pending workload is shut down before independently restored sysfs and empty journal; separate reopened no-IMPORT epoch gets fresh leases and finishes; killed epoch performs a second real I/O cycle.

source_review.name: persistent_crash_barrier
source_review.evidence: Two same-ID restart attempts require nonzero/no-ready/exact unresolved-grant reason and unchanged original records; helper receives TERM and actual wait0 before new PID restart and raw journal reload comparison.

source_review.name: admin_reconciliation
source_review.evidence: UID1000 and UID1001 are rejected by distinct actual JSON errors; root refuses same-generation unrestored baseline, guest administrator binds original drivers, independent sysfs matches before root returns retired/restored and pending becomes empty.

source_review.name: actual_io_and_disconnection
source_review.evidence: QMP key1/key2 plus raw evdev down/up records, FTDI RX/TX per-cycle35B and host70B exact sink; current sessions/receipts verified before stop, spontaneous VHCI NULL/old nodes gone observed before explicit detach.

source_review.name: honest_killed_epoch
source_review.evidence: Killed epoch terminal snapshot/resources remain null/unobservable; no stopped event allowed, driver-null after kill is an explicit current guard-slice fact, not automatic recovery success.

source_review.name: channels_and_terminal_result
source_review.evidence: Kernel ttyS0 separated from strict JSON/control evidence ttyS1; both beacons and collection markers required; kernel faults or FAIL markers sticky; both QEMU exits and exact injections/TX required before PASS.

source_review.name: source_and_binary_guards
source_review.evidence: Native+physical+journal layered fingerprints cover Rust/Cargo/vendor and seven harness inputs; source copies, actual guest ELF identity, original/final Git/source/binary values recorded; no skip-build path.
